# GitLocal

> GitLocal is a free, local-first, GitHub-style viewer for local folders and git repositories. It is built for browsing codebases, reading Markdown, reviewing changes, and making small edits without opening a full IDE.

GitLocal runs entirely on the user's machine, with no accounts or telemetry. Clone, fetch, pull, and push actions go through the user's locally installed `git` only, and only when the user chooses to run them. It ships as a cross-platform npm package (macOS, Windows, Linux) and a native macOS app (beta, via Homebrew).

Core features: a lazy-loading keyboard-navigable file tree, GitHub-like Markdown rendering with relative links and heading anchors, a changed-files review panel, repository-wide search, a plain-language git status summary, safe local file/folder editing with revision-token conflict protection, and an integrated terminal docked to the right, left, or bottom of the window (plain shell tabs) for handing work back to an AI coding agent.

## Site
- [Features](https://gitlocal.dev/features/): Overview of everything GitLocal does, with a page for each topic: [browse](https://gitlocal.dev/features/browse/), [search](https://gitlocal.dev/features/search/), [Markdown](https://gitlocal.dev/features/markdown/), [file previews](https://gitlocal.dev/features/previews/), [review changes](https://gitlocal.dev/features/review/), [git state](https://gitlocal.dev/features/git-state/), [safe edits](https://gitlocal.dev/features/edit/), [terminal](https://gitlocal.dev/features/terminal/)
- [Install](https://gitlocal.dev/install/): npm and macOS app install steps, requirements, upgrade, and uninstall
- [Community](https://gitlocal.dev/community/): Ways to take part
- [FAQ](https://gitlocal.dev/faq/): Common questions

## Install
- npm (macOS, Windows, Linux): `npm install -g gitlocal` then `gitlocal .`, or `npx gitlocal` to try without installing
- Homebrew (macOS app, beta): `brew tap ehud-am/gitlocal && brew install --cask gitlocal`
